Dataset: Synthetic control-treatment expression study. Molecular layer: rna. Target contrast:
condition (treatment versus control). Sampling design: cross-sectional biological samples. 99
of 99 independent biological observation resamples completed the full assessment; 0 did not.
Resampling used target stratified biological unit bootstrap. In component-indexed panels, the
red triangle marks the nominated component and black circles mark comparisons. Components are
matched jointly one-to-one by maximum total absolute feature-loading cosine. Axis recurrence is
the fraction assigned to the same discovery axis; higher absolute loading cosine indicates a
closer match; larger assignment margin indicates less ambiguity. Subspace points are
per-resample largest principal angles for each enclosing dimension. Smaller subspace angles
indicate more recurrent enclosing subspaces. No stability threshold is applied; evidence is
descriptive and does not establish biological validity.
